name: SaveGame_Save
notes: thiscall; writes header, saves modules to memory stream, compresses, writes file

name: SaveGame_LoadModules
notes: loads 17 modules in order, verifies 4-byte tag after each (SAD)

name: Debug_Printf
notes: EMPTY in retail build: all debug/assert output compiled out. arg0 = condition or channel (0, 2, 0x499602d2)

name: crt_atexit
notes: registers destructor in MSVC function-static init guard pattern

name: FileStream_Open
notes: allocates 8-byte stream object with vtable FileStream_vtable, calls vtbl+0x24 open

name: Stream_Read
notes: (result*, stream, buf, len) via vtbl+0x08; result = (bytesRead == len)

name: Stream_Tell
notes: vtbl+0x18; used for 'X: loaded %d bytes' deltas

name: MemStream_Open
notes: used by SaveGame_Save to save into memory first

name: Buffer_Compress
notes: compresses save buffer; 'Need to allocate a bigger buffer'

name: Buffer_Decompress
notes: inverse of Buffer_Compress via the compressor singleton (slot 2); used by saves and .wct v0x12

name: Compressor_Get
notes: returns the global compressor singleton (concrete vtable 0x703128)

name: ZlibCompressor_Compress
notes: writes the 28-byte BILZ header (magic, unpacked, packed, windowBits 15, level 9, 0, 0) + zlib stream

name: ZlibCompressor_Decompress
notes: checks BILZ magic, inflateInit2_ / inflate(Z_FINISH) / inflateEnd

name: zlib_inflateInit2_
notes: statically linked zlib 1.1.3 (version string '1.1.3', stream size 0x38)

name: ActionRec_Serialize
notes: (stream, isSave, ?, ?) — called with isSave=0 on load, 1 on save; GActionRec

name: Advisor_Save
notes: module ADVS; original logs 'Coasters: saved' here (copy-paste bug)

name: UI_Save
notes: last module; original logs 'UI: loaded' here (copy-paste bug)

name: RSSE_ExecuteInstruction
notes: fetches one code word, dispatches via 106-entry jump table (0x5567d8); needs tools/FixJumpTable.java to decompile. ctx: +0x18 code*, +0x1c vars*, +0x3c pc (-10000 = error), +0x50 code_len

name: RSSE_OpcodeHandlerTable
notes: 106 handler addresses indexed by opcode; see re/rsse_opcodes.csv

name: RSSE_LoadScriptFile
notes: 'Not a RSSE script file', 'Zero length script', 'Cannot load Script file'

name: RSSE_KillScript
notes: 'Cant kill a script - system is not initialised'

name: RSSE_SetupWalkNodes
notes: walk/head node validation, 'Walknodes need a setwalk'

name: Engine_Init
notes: 'Initializing engine internals'; logs a checkpoint after each renderer subsystem (… 'wavelet/printf ok')

name: Wavelet_Init
notes: creates the global wavelet codec (DAT_00879a64) during Engine_Init

name: WaveletCodec_Create
notes: allocates 0x58 bytes and constructs; returns the IWaveletCodec interface pointer

name: WaveletCodec_Construct
notes: builds clamp table (0xc27008) and 16-bit pixel tables, allocates work buffers

name: WaveletCodec_Encode
notes: RGB -> YUV float planes -> forward D4 -> quantise (1/q) -> Buffer_Compress

name: WaveletCodec_Decode
notes: dispatch on format version: 0x12 -> vtable slot 0 (DecodeV12), 0x13 -> slot 2 (DecodeV13)

name: WaveletCodec_DecodeV12
notes: one-level D4 like v0x13 but rows stored [all low, all high]; streams are BILZ (zlib); ported in tools/wct2png.py

name: WaveletCodec_DecodeV13
notes: one-level D4 wavelet, YUV 4:2:0 + optional alpha; ported in tools/wct2png.py

name: WaveletCodec_DecodeV13Scaled
notes: resampling variant; calls DecodeV13 when sizes match

name: Wavelet_ReadBits
notes: LSB-first bit reader over 16-bit LE words

name: TextureSet_Load
notes: builds dir+name, forces '.wct', 'Could not load texture %s'

name: VFS_Open
notes: tries the mounted WAD archives first, then the disk

name: UITexture_Construct
notes: thiscall(name); loads UI textures such as 'happygrad.wct'

name: WaveletCodec_InitD4Filter
notes: 4 static-initialiser stubs (0x591600/30/60/90) computing D4 h0..h3 into 0xc27208..14 via x87; not functions in Ghidra

name: Texture_DecodeWct
notes: computes quantiser steps from header q (Y 1+q/2, Cb/Cr 1+q/4, A q+1; constants 0x7011b8..c4) and calls WaveletCodec_Decode

name: RSSE_Tick
notes: scheduler: runs each script every 8th tick ((id^tick)&7==0) or every tick if TURBO; budget = header[0x10]; CRIT_LOCK instructions are free

name: RSSE_FetchWord
notes: next code word; pc=-10000 on overrun

name: RSSE_OperandValue
notes: variable value, or immediate sign-extended from 16 bits

name: GameClock_Now
notes: fastcall; base time + offset at +0x48; used for all RSSE waits

name: World_Rand
notes: LCG x*0x19660d+0x3c6ef35f, rotr 13, abs; state at world+0x1da708. Must be bit-exact for determinism

name: RSSE_ScriptList
notes: head of doubly linked list of live script contexts (0xF4 bytes each)

name: MD2_Load
notes: loads a .md2 mesh: magic 0x1CD15D46, version <=0xDE; relocates ~18 header offsets and nested table pointers

name: Save_FieldName
notes: (size, name, isLoad) debug stub, compiled to 'return 0'; every serializer announces each field through it, which names the save format

name: SaveGame_WriteHeader
notes: u8 language, 0x500 UTF-16 legal text, 0x100 block, u32 BE magic 0x01221985, u32 has-preview

name: SaveGame_ReadHeader
notes: mirror of SaveGame_WriteHeader; rejects edited legal text

name: Thing_Serialize
notes: CThing base: u16 mX, mY (8.8 fixed-point cell coords), mMapChild, mMapParent

name: WorldGlobals_Serialize
notes: staff pool, game clock, park gates

name: ParkGates_Serialize
notes: arrival rate, bus capacity, gates open

name: Map_Serialize
notes: 128x128 cells; per-cell status byte: bit0 map cell, bit1 track cell, bit2 RE cell

name: MapCellBase_Serialize
notes: 29 bytes: direction, flags, mesh instance, neighbours, overlap, parent, tile data, type, hoarding

name: Staff_Serialize
notes: staff base: pay grade, UTF-16 name[0x21], patrol region, time hired

name: ParkAnalyser_Serialize
notes: thing model 13: 32x32 analysis grid + circular-buffer statistics

name: BankAccount_Serialize
notes: thing model 16: balance, admission fee, 8 loans

name: SoundBank_OpenSdt
notes: appends HD.sdt or HW.sdt to the bank path and opens it, falling back to the other; arg3 == 0 tries HW first

name: LbMpeg_MmxTransform
notes: MMX int16 transform over 8 qwords using the Q14 cosine table in section lbmpeg_d (0xfc0000); likely MPEG decoder matrixing

name: CircBufU32_30_Serialize
notes: ring buffer of 30 u32 (mTemp, mData[30], mCurrentEntry, mNumEntries, mWrappedAround); 6 per Object

name: World_Tick
notes: increments the tick counter at +0x1da70c and calls Thing_Update for every live thing (skips things whose byte +3 is set)

name: Thing_Update
notes: per-tick dispatch on Thing.model (byte +2); most models call an Update and a PostUpdate method

name: Thing_HandleMessage
notes: dispatch on Thing.model to the model's message handler; called from the message centre (0x40fb10)

name: Thing_SetPos
notes: sets mX/mY; asserts "Attempt to move thing to invalid..." when the cell id is >= 0x4001

name: Mechanic_PostUpdate
notes: Thing_Update case 4 (second call; the first goes through a thunk to 0x505490)

name: Staff_HandleMessageDefault
notes: Thing_HandleMessage for both Entertainer (6) and Researcher (8)

name: Advisor_Update
notes: Thing_Update case 11 (works on a global; skipped when DAT_00fb3b7c == 1)

name: Model18_HandleMessage
notes: Thing_HandleMessage case 18 (model 18 is unidentified; its update, 0x4f7c60 + 0x4f7c90, only runs when DAT_00fb3b7c == 1)

name: Challenges_Update
notes: Thing_Update case 19 (works on a global; skipped when DAT_00fb3b7c == 1)

name: Visitor_ScoreOption
notes: thiscall(visitor, object); 'Calculating option score': distance, queue, thirst/hunger/toilet/illness match

name: Visitor_UseObject
notes: thiscall(visitor, object); applies the object def effects (+0x144 thirst, +0x148 hunger, +0x14c illness, +0x150 happiness, +0x154 litter) to the needs, balloons, costumes, sideshow wins

name: Staff_TireA
notes: drains mEnergy and mHappiness by (6 - pay grade) * rate; one of two rates

name: Staff_TireB
notes: as Staff_TireA with the other pair of rates

name: Staff_GetWage
notes: per-type factor (DAT_00785380) * pay grade table (DAT_0078532c, stride 0x10)

name: Object_GetDef
notes: fastcall; ObjectDefs_Find(this->mId at +0xe); the def holds balance values (effects at +0x144..+0x15c)

name: ObjectDefs_Find
notes: thiscall; linear search of def pointers (count at +0x528) by leading u16 id, one-entry cache at +0x730

name: BalanceFile_Init
notes: thiscall; base of every .sam-backed class: walks the key schema (vtable slot 0) and assigns each value a 4-byte slot of the storage (slot 1); tables reserve rows*keys+1

name: BalanceFile_SetDefaults
notes: type 6 -> min, type 9 -> fmin, others 0; 'InitialiseBalanceValues internal' error

name: BalanceFile_Parse
notes: parses Group.Key value lines; 'Balance file %s parse error', range checks per type

name: ObjectDef_GetSchema
notes: returns &key record i of the object .sam schema at 0x744b30 (0x3c bytes each)

name: ObjectDef_Ctor
notes: vtable at +4 (0x6fd8a8) then BalanceFile_Init; zeroes runtime fields 0x494..0x500

name: ObjectDefs_Load
notes: allocates an ObjectDef (max 0x14a), copies the .sam path to +0x28c and parses it

name: gBalanceHoardingsB
notes: BalanceHoardings: the other of Hoardings.sam / EndHoardings.sam (ctor 0x402a90)

name: BalanceHoardings_GetSchema
notes: returns &key record i of the schema at 0x73fb40

name: BalanceLevel_GetSchema
notes: returns &key record i of the schema at 0x73fc70

name: BalanceOnline_GetSchema
notes: returns &key record i of the schema at 0x743f00

name: BalanceGraphics_GetSchema
notes: returns &key record i of the schema at 0x7442c0

name: BalanceResolution_GetSchema
notes: returns &key record i of the schema at 0x744a40

name: BalanceSound_GetSchema
notes: returns &key record i of the schema at 0x746a20

name: BalanceFile_GetValues
notes: returns this+8 (vtable slot 1 of every balance class)

name: HeightMap_LoadOrBuild
notes: loads <model>.hmp (magic 0xab1e0003, 0x00640005), rebuilds and rewrites it when missing or the footprint differs; result at model+0xcc

name: HeightMap_Build
notes: allocates header + w*h*0x1b bytes; 5x5 cells per tile, tile max heights, footprint flags

name: HeightMap_Rasterize
notes: rasterises model triangles into the cell grid; height byte = y*2.55, y clamped to [0,100)

name: Scape_LoadObjects
notes: reads Scape.omp OBJ_ records: type 1 point sound, 2 particle effect, 3 area sound; coords /1024

name: Sound_PlayAt
notes: (owner, category, sound, x, y, z): posts a positional play command via the sound manager vtable +8

name: Sound_PlayAtRange
notes: Sound_PlayAt with an extra range float

name: Sound_SetArea
notes: (sound, x, z, w, d): spreads an emitter over the rect (x, z)..(x+w, z+d)

name: Particle_Spawn
notes: (effect 0..0x68, x, y, z in 1/1024 units); pool of 0x140-byte systems

name: SoundCategory_Register
notes: loads a cat_<name> sound category (bank + map)

name: Sound_RegisterGlobalCategories
notes: cat_ambient, cat_rides, cat_ui, cat_kids, cat_staff, cat_speech

name: Sound_RegisterThemeCategories
notes: theme folder's cat_ambient, cat_rides, cat_speech, cat_music

name: Terrain_Load
notes: loads <theme>/Terrain base.md2 (or TestBase), flags steep grid squares, then base.lnd when procedural textures are on

name: TerrainTex_Load
notes: refuses when procedural textures are disabled, else TerrainTex_Init

name: TerrainTex_Init
notes: allocates the 0x10014-byte tile cache and reads the .lnd

name: TerrainTexCache_Update
notes: LRU tile cache keyed by (x, y); blends missing tiles

name: Lnd_Read
notes: base.lnd: version 3, 5 blend ramps, 384x344x4 control map, 3 detail levels of 13 textures

name: Lnd_ReadLevel
notes: u32 tile size, u8 level, 13 x Array3D_Read

name: Lnd_Clear
notes: level i gets tile size 0x40 >> i

name: Array3D_Read
notes: u32 w, h, bpp + w*h*bpp bytes

name: Sign_Apply
notes: splits a name into two lines, loads <theme>/<style>.sgn, renders it onto the model's sign1/sign2.tga with GDI

name: SignStyle_Ctor
notes: two line styles, default LOGFONT Arial Black, weight 400

name: SignStyle_Load
notes: .sgn: version >= 100, 2 line styles (font, ttf, x, y, LOGFONTA, layout), effects, 2 fill strips, background

name: Array3D_ReadCompressed
notes: u32 w, h, bpp + float quantisers + BILZ wavelet streams, decoded via IWaveletCodec slot 3

name: WaveletCodec_DecodePlanes
notes: vtable slot 3: colour -> 0x592730, grey -> 0x592e60; takes float quantiser steps

name: WaveletCodec_DecodeColourStream
notes: Buffer_Decompress, then Y (q1), Cb (q2), Cr (q3) planes, inverse D4, YUV->RGB

name: Advisor_Say
notes: 'Advisor says ResponseID %d': looks up gAdvisorResponses, loads Speech/lips/sp_%03d.lip, starts gesture and animation

name: Advisor_UpdateSpeech
notes: plays the sample 200 ms after the animation starts; toggles the mouth at each .lip time

name: gAdvisorResponses
notes: 0x20-byte rows: response id, sample, lip number, gesture, theme<<16|anim, ?, ?, ?; ends with 9999

name: Sprites_LoadAll
notes: loads every esprites.wad folder in gSpriteFolders order; arg 1 = particles only

name: Sprites_LoadFolder
notes: finds *.ESP in a folder; loads gAvatarSprites first ('Loading Avatar Sprites')

name: Sprite_LoadEsp
notes: thiscall; reads ESP_FILE2.00 (name, 2 flags, 16 anims, 4 actions) then the .tpc/.fpc frames

name: Sprite_GetAction
notes: thiscall; special action 0..3 -> animation slot, entry in 0x74f7c8 table, 2 bytes

name: Sprite_GetAnimFrameCount
notes: thiscall; frame count byte of an animation slot

name: Sprites_UseGroundFrames
notes: reloads .fpc frames for sprites whose ESP ground-frames flag is set

name: SpriteFrames_Load
notes: reads a .tpc/.fpc stream into a frame set

name: Camera_SetMode
notes: 2 = walk, 4 = follow a thing, 0x40 = park view; flags in gCameraFlags

name: Camera_ToggleWalkMode
notes: switches sprite frame sets with the camera

name: Camera_FollowThing
notes: sets camera mode 4 on a thing and picks the sprite frame set

name: gSpriteFolders
notes: 14 x (char* folder, first sprite index, count)

name: ParticleLib_Load
notes: reads Data/Particle/Tp2.plb: effects (0x140) into 0x804370, effectors (0x68) into 0x80c6b0, 2 settings

name: Particle_Emit
notes: emits one particle from a live system (spawn volume, lifetime, colour)

name: Particles_Update
notes: ages particles: ramp colour, sprite frame, size, random kick, drag; spawns the on-death effect

name: Particles_SetReduced
notes: sets 0x80ced8; optional effects (record byte 0xc1) are not spawned

name: gParticleSystems
notes: live systems: 0x140-byte copies of an effect definition
